events.headline: ONE KILLED AND DOZENS INJURED IN IRANIAN DRONE STRIKES ON KUWAIT AIRPORT
events.detail: Iran says the attack on Kuwait was in retaliation for earlier US strikes on an Iranian oil tanker and island.
